court: Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit

issues.label: Jurisdiction over petition for review
issues.why: Court must confirm it has authority to review the BIA's denial of the motion to reopen.

issues.label: Standard of review for reopening denial
issues.why: Denials of motions to reopen are typically reviewed for abuse of discretion, framing the analysis.

issues.label: Legality of quantitative evidence requirement
issues.why: Whether the BIA erred in holding CAT requires quantitative rather than anecdotal evidence.

issues.label: Improper rejection of expert report
issues.why: Whether dismissing the expert's prison-conditions descriptions as mere anecdote was legal error.

issues.label: Prior remand instructions on expert weight
issues.why: BIA previously faulted underweighting of expert evidence; consistency with that mandate must be assessed.

issues.label: Definition of 'new or previously unavailable' evidence
issues.why: Whether ongoing/continuing conditions can qualify as new evidence for reopening.

issues.label: Continuation-of-abuse rationale for exclusion
issues.why: Whether rejecting evidence as continuation of pre-hearing abuse improperly categorically bars changed-conditions claims.

issues.label: Changed country conditions since hearing
issues.why: Whether worsening or evolving State of Exception conditions constitute material changed circumstances.

issues.label: Prima facie eligibility for CAT relief
issues.why: Whether Parada showed a reasonable likelihood of establishing torture is more likely than not.

issues.label: Aggregation of all torture risk evidence
issues.why: Whether BIA erred by piecemeal dismissal instead of considering evidence cumulatively.

issues.label: Government/consent-acquiescence element of torture
issues.why: CAT requires torture by or with acquiescence of officials, relevant to detention conditions.

issues.label: Likelihood of detention finding
issues.why: BIA found reasonable likelihood of detention; its interaction with torture risk must be evaluated.

issues.label: Adequacy of BIA's reasoning/explanation
issues.why: Whether the BIA sufficiently explained its evidentiary and merits conclusions for meaningful review.

issues.label: Effect of unchallenged equitable tolling
issues.why: Timeliness was resolved via tolling; scope of remaining reviewable issues depends on this.

issues.label: Relationship to companion petition 24-7433
issues.why: Overlapping asylum/withholding/CAT review may affect consolidation or preclusion.

issues.label: Remand versus resolution as remedy
issues.why: Court must decide whether to remand for reconsideration under correct standards or resolve directly.

issues.label: Deference owed to agency legal interpretation
issues.why: Whether the BIA's evidentiary rule warrants deference or is a reviewable legal error.

issues.label: Prejudice from applying erroneous standard
issues.why: Whether any legal error was harmless or affected the outcome.
